sources.title: Building a Small Language Model(SLM) from Scratch - GitHub
sources.snippet: A step-by-step Jupyter Notebook demonstrating how to build and train a compact small language model ("SLM") from scratch using the TinyStories dataset. Covers data preparation, BPE tokenization, efficient binary storage, GPU memory locking, Transformer architecture, training configuration, and sample text generation.
